# pdfmake

Bundled with Task Proxy to save a project page as a PDF (`wc/page-export.js`). These are the published builds, copied unchanged, so do not edit or re-minify them.

| File | Package | Version |
|---|---|---|
| `pdfmake.min.js`, `vfs_fonts.js` | `pdfmake` | 0.3.13 |

pdfmake is MIT licensed by its authors (see `LICENSE`), and `vfs_fonts.js` holds the Roboto fonts, under the Apache License 2.0. To update, copy `build/pdfmake.min.js` and `build/vfs_fonts.js` from the `pdfmake` package, then update this table.
